description: This file defines the PurgeEmployeeAPI class in PHP, which implements an API endpoint for purging employee data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for deleting employee records and establishing validation rules, utilizing related models and services.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for purging employee data, providing methods for deleting an employee and validation, extending the Endpoint class and implementing CollectionEndpoint.

methods.name: getPurgeService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the PurgeService instance used to perform purge operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to purge an employee's data based on employee number provided in request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation, ensuring 'empNumber' is within accessible employee numbers.
